items.sentence: Complainant stated that she had previously filed an EEO complaint in [MASK], which remained pending before an EEOC Administrative Judge (AJ) at the time of her affidavit for the instant EEO complaint.
Complainant explained that the sexual harassment/assault occurred in [MASK] after which she went on Family & Medical Leave Act (FMLA) leave.
She stated that she was released to return to work at a different facility from her harasser in [MASK], but when she arrived at work, her harasser was still there.
She further alleged that in [MASK], she suffered a knee injury in the workplace, and she submitted documents to the Agency pertaining to her knee injury in July 2020, but received no response.
She stated that in [MASK], she was finally given a modified assignment to a different location that accommodated her physical restrictions. 2 See ROI at 100.
